title: Maximum K-Sum Pairs
description: Given an integer array `nums` and target `k`, repeatedly choose two different remaining elements whose sum is `k` and remove them. Return the maximum number of pairs that can be removed. Input: `nums`, `k`. Output: the pair count.
hints: Sort once or track a compact running state to avoid checking every possible group.
Test duplicates, extreme ordering, and cases with no feasible candidate.
